node.title: Re: What Perl object am I looking at here?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
print $object->countries; I get back: HASH(0x559dd38dad20)HASH(0x559dd378be08) ...

Looks to me like that method call is returning a list of hashrefs, because [doc://print] provides list context to its arguments, and it's not putting any whitespace in between the arguments ([doc://$,]). In other words, if you do my @countries = $object->countries;, I think you should get an array of hashes. See [doc://perldsc] for some examples of how to work with such data structures.

BTW, you never mention what module this is, or what your [doc://Data::Dumper] output looks like; both of which would allow us to give you the definitive answer to "I'd like to know what it is that I have on my hands." My answer above is an educated guess, but for the best help, please provide as much information as possible, best is always an [id://1177642|SSCCE].
